nimbus_pending_change_shape.name: nimbus_pending_change_shape
nimbus_pending_change_shape.value: (kind IN ('trash', 'restore') AND trash_id IS NOT NULL AND from_path IS NULL AND to_path IS NULL) OR (kind = 'move' AND trash_id IS NULL AND from_path IS NOT NULL AND to_path IS NOT NULL)

nimbus_device_pairing_decision.name: nimbus_device_pairing_decision
nimbus_device_pairing_decision.value: ("nimbus_device_pairing"."state" IN ('approved', 'redeemed')) = ("nimbus_device_pairing"."owner_id" IS NOT NULL AND "nimbus_device_pairing"."library_id" IS NOT NULL)

nimbus_library_poster_dimensions.name: nimbus_library_poster_dimensions
nimbus_library_poster_dimensions.value: ("nimbus_library_poster"."state" = 'ready') = ("nimbus_library_poster"."width" IS NOT NULL AND "nimbus_library_poster"."height" IS NOT NULL AND "nimbus_library_poster"."width" > 0 AND "nimbus_library_poster"."height" > 0)
